summary.caption: Wide cinematic anime-fantasy key art in deep midnight blue, charcoal black, glowing crimson, pale moonlight silver and starlight white. Sample Hero, a long-haired blonde elf-eared woman with blue eyes, stands right of center in ornate armor, holding a diagonal glowing crimson blade that sweeps toward the lower-left text cluster. A colossal crowned celestial deity looms in the upper-left sky, a giant moon fills the upper right, and Gothic spires frame the dark horizon. Smaller companion silhouettes flank her, with volumetric light, drifting embers and matte-painting detail. Original serif title lettering sits on the left with secondary copy and a launch date across the lower thirds.
